input.prompt: Editorial advertising photograph, shot on medium-format film. A single matte pale sage-green aluminium can of sparkling water stands on a wet slab of dark grey granite at the edge of a still, cold northern lake at first light. Low mist drifts over the water; a soft line of black spruce on the far shore. Real condensation beads on the can. Cool natural overcast light with a faint warm glow at the horizon. The can sits on the right third of the frame; the left two-thirds is calm open mist and water, generous negative space. Restrained palette of slate, sage and bone. Fine film grain, true to life, quiet and premium. A small minimal label on the can reads ALDER in black serif capitals, nothing else. No other text, no logos.
